dimensions.assessment: Potentially affects any individual interacting with covered federal agencies who chooses to use the voluntary change of address notification service.
dimensions.evidence: establish an online form through which an individual may... transmit to any covered agency selected by such individual... a notification of a change in the mailing or residential address

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative convenience for individuals updating addresses and streamlines government record-keeping without altering underlying benefit eligibility.
dimensions.evidence: use the information included in such transmission to update the mailing or residential address of the individual... in each record maintained by such agency

dimensions.assessment: No additional funds are authorized to be appropriated; covered agencies reimburse the GSA administrator from existing appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: No additional funds are authorized to be appropriated for the purpose of carrying out this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a temporary pilot program across specific federal agencies and coordinates with IRS regulations, while explicitly prohibiting centralized address databases.
dimensions.evidence: The Administrator shall establish a pilot program for voluntary Federal change of address notification service

dimensions.assessment: Operates as a pilot program with a mandatory termination date 5 years after the form is first made available (or 3 years if not established).
dimensions.evidence: This section, and the authorities provided under this section, shall terminate--(1) on the date that is 5 years after the date on which the form established under subsection (a) is first made available

missing_information: The exact administrative cost sharing amounts and reimbursement levels determined by the GSA Administrator.
importance_detail.rationale: The Tell the Government Once Act establishes a 5-year pilot program operated by the GSA providing a centralized online form for individuals to update their mailing or residential addresses across participating federal agencies like the IRS, SSA, VA, and USPS.
